issue.title: just check-full hangs silently at test-cost: cost lease holder stops heartbeating and the holder watchdog never self-reclaims
issue.description: Silent multi-hour test-cost hang under suite-gate contention observed twice while landing epic sase-wn (proposed by phase bead sase-wn.10, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #3); routed here by the sase-wn land agent. Details in the repro field.

task_type_fields.impact: `just check-full` is the monitor-only landing gate (two-speed verification), so a silent multi-hour hang burns the landing monitor's entire budget, blocks the epic land agent, and — because the lease is host-wide — can starve sibling workspaces' suite runs for hours. sase-wn.10's close note explicitly warns the next agent not to treat another silent test-cost hang as a product failure; until this is fixed, every landing that hits contention pays hours of wall clock for zero signal.
task_type_fields.location: Justfile:674 test-cost step; suite-gate/cost lease holder + watchdog (tests/test_suite_gate_reclaim.py family, cost plugin)
task_type_fields.repro:
Run `just check-full` on a host where another workspace holds or contends the suite-gate/test-cost lease. Twice during the sase-wn.10 landing (2026-09-05) the run hung silently at the `test cost` step (Justfile:674, no output):

1. A 2h monitor budget expired (SIGTERM) during silent test-cost; lint/fmt/symvision/validation were all green.
2. A 5h retry also timed out: cost lease pid 1399794 started 15:12:55Z, heartbeated normally through 17:14:26Z (progress 1396, ~2h1m of 5s-throttled calls), then produced NO heartbeats for ~2h53m until the monitor killed it at 20:07Z. No cost recording was written, and the holder watchdog never self-reclaimed the lease.

Phase tests were provably not the hang: the 165 idle-guardrail/import-budget/trigger/status/dashboard tests passed in 11.5s in the same tree. Uncontended, test-cost is ~38k items / ~90m.

Two distinct symptoms, likely one incident: (a) the test-cost run itself hangs silently mid-flight with no progress output, and (b) the stale-holder watchdog does not reclaim a live-but-silent holder, so the hang wedges the host-wide gate. (b)'s reclaim path also has a deterministic failing test tracked separately in sase-w7 (test_waiter_reclaims_stale_live_holder); see the related link.

payload.description: deterministic failing test of the same stale-live-holder reclaim path (test_waiter_reclaims_stale_live_holder); fixing that reclaim would unwedge symptom (b) here
Same test-cost lane, different defect: sase-x4 hangs silently before budget evaluation (stuck cost-lease holder); sase-xc is a deterministic budget-evaluation failure after a clean run.
